title: State-of-the-art of industrial PET mechanical recycling: technologies, impact of contamination and guidelines for decision-making
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,1996-2047
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00571F, Critical Review

Erion Bezeraj, Simon Debrie, Francisco J. Arraez, Pablo Reyes, Paul H. M. Van Steenberge, Dagmar R. D'hooge, Mariya Edeleva
A design of PET mechanical recycling at the industrial scale requires the inspection of the relevance of pre-treatment steps, degradation reactions and repair potential, accounting for the impact of contamination (e.g. NIAS) and regulations.
